title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A 34-year-old shut-in who wasted his life dies and is reborn as Rudeus Greyrat in a world of magic, keeping his adult memories. Resolving to live seriously this time, he grows up studying magic, forming relationships and surviving a disaster that scatters him far from home (to verify). The manga adapts the web novel by Rifujin na Magonote.
life_message: It holds up a second chance: taking life seriously, working hard and building family where the first life was wasted.
